title: Computer Science - Brian Kernighan on successful language design
summary: Brian Kernighan gives a talk at the University of Nottingham on how to succeed in language design without really trying. He draws on his experience with awk and other languages.
why: HN cites it as a practical talk on language design and for background on awk from one of its authors.

quote.text: This is an excellent talk on designing successful programming language by Brian Kernighan
